text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock D, E and A after gains felt good, but I should let investment prospects—not the satisfaction of locking in profits—guide when I sell.","I sold Stock A at a loss and later bought it again, while also selling Stock C at a loss. I should reassess each holding objectively rather than let regret or my purchase price dictate the decision.","Before adding to positions such as Stocks B and A, I should consider the portfolio’s overall risk and available cash, not just recent price moves or a desire to recover losses."]}
